crossRefs.note: Yahweh, you have heard the desire of the humble. You will prepare their heart. You will cause your ear to hear,
One thing I have asked of Yahweh, that I will seek after: that I may dwell in Yahweh’s house all the days of my life…
Also delight yourself in Yahweh, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
Now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in you.
Deliver me from all my transgressions. Don’t make me the reproach of the foolish.
Oh that my ways were steadfast to obey your statutes!
With my whole heart, I have sought you. Don’t let me wander from your commandments.
With my soul I have desired you in the night. Yes, with my spirit within me I will seek you earnestly; for when your…
As for me, I have not hurried from being a shepherd after you. I haven’t desired the woeful day. You know. That which…
Blessed are those who hunger and thirst after righteousness, for they shall be filled.
When a wicked man dies, hope perishes, and expectation of power comes to nothing.
The prospect of the righteous is joy, but the hope of the wicked will perish.
but to those who are self-seeking, and don’t obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, will be wrath, indignation,
oppression, and anguish on every soul of man who does evil, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
but a certain fearful expectation of judgment, and a fierceness of fire which will devour the adversaries.

translations.web: The desire of the righteous is only good. The expectation of the wicked is wrath.
translations.bsb: The desire of the righteous leads only to good, but the hope of the wicked brings wrath.
translations.kjv: The desire of the righteous is only good: but the expectation of the wicked is wrath.
translations.asv: The desire of the righteous is only good; But the expectation of the wicked is wrath.
